subject: Integra MAP: evaluation milestones, hosting selection, and contract timing
messages:
From: Samuel Bright <samuel.bright@integrai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carmen Lee <carmen.lee@cloudpartner.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: MAP & hosting options (hosted / dedicated / private)

Priyom —

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. We sketched a mutual action plan internally and I wanted to start with a minimal set of milestones so we can lock hosting mode and region before Q3 procurement windows close. High level asks from my side:

- Confirm which deployment modes Redwood recommends for a production PII-sensitive integration (latency target <200ms p95).
- Align on a 2-week eval cadence we can run in our staging environment (hosted smoke -> dedicated perf) and who owns what.
- Procurement needs a tentative pricing/term outline and an SOW draft by 7/26 to hit our board review on 8/2.

Attached is our one-page MAP outline — it lists evaluation checkpoints and data access constraints. Can Redwood share a recommended MAP timeline (no more than three decision gates) and the artifacts you need from us?

Sam
Samuel Bright
Director, Product Integrations
Integra Health
[Attachment: Integra-MAP-v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Samuel Bright <samuel.bright@integrai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Carmen Lee <carmen.lee@cloudpartner.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & hosting options (hosted / dedicated / private)

Sam —

Thanks for the clear list. I sketched a compact MAP below so it maps to your board timeline. Quick summary up front: we recommend running a short hosted-first smoke test to validate functional correctness, then a focused 10-business-day dedicated perf window if you need consistent p95 latency under load. Private (VPC/on-prem) remains on the table for later if compliance gating requires it, but that path has longer lead time (~6-8 weeks).

Proposed MAP (3 gates):
1) Week 0 (hosted smoke, 3 days): confirm API integration, data flows, and functionality. Redwood provides temporary isolated org + limited tokens.
2) Week 1-2 (dedicated perf, 10 business days): reserved GPU pool, load tests, latency/cost profile. Redwood provides perf report + tuning recommendations.
3) Week 3 (decision & procurement inputs): Redwood delivers SOW draft, pricing, SOC2 summary, and recommended rollout plan.

If that sounds good I can route a SOW draft and perf checklist by EOD tomorrow. What specific latency SLA language does procurement want to see for the board packet?

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW-draft.docx (DOCX)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samuel Bright <samuel.bright@integrai.com>, Carmen Lee <carmen.lee@cloudpartner.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 13:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & hosting options (hosted / dedicated / private)

Looping in a short technical recommendation:

- If Integra's primary concern is strict p95 latency under steady traffic, Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) gives predictable latency and is our default rec for production-critical flows.
- Hosted is the fastest path to validate functionality and edge-case handling but you may see more variance under bursty traffic.
- Private/VPC should be scoped only if your security team requires customer-managed networking and HSM integration; plan for a 6-week minimum onboarding window and validation run.

Operational asks for the dedicated window: access to a replayable traffic trace (anonymized) and a 72-hour blocked maintenance window where Integra can run perf sweeps. We will instrument KV-cache, batching, and quantization profiles to hit the <200ms p95 target.

Karthik
Principal Product Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Carmen Lee <carmen.lee@cloudpartner.io>
To: Samuel Bright <samuel.bright@integrai.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & hosting options (hosted / dedicated / private)

Hi all —

Quick note from the partner side: if Integra plans dedicated capacity in our region (us-west-2), we can provision a private VLAN to accelerate the Dedicated rollout and reduce network variance. That can shave 1-2 weeks off the dedicated onboarding timeline. We'll need contact for your infra lead and a short topology diagram.

Carmen
Cloud Partner Solutions
CloudPartner.io

From: Procurement <procurement@integrai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Samuel Bright <samuel.bright@integrai.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & hosting options (hosted / dedicated / private)

Team —

Thanks for the MAP draft — procurement reviewed and we need the following items by 7/26 to make our board packet:
- Finalized SOW (deliverable list + acceptance criteria)
- Pricing table for hosted vs dedicated (1-month, 6-month, annual commits) + estimated token/throughput assumptions
- SOC2 summary and data retention policy (redact any internal IDs)

Priyom: can you confirm Redwood will provide a one-page latency SLA blurb for inclusion and a draft SOW by COB 7/26? If yes, we'll lock the evaluation schedule (hosted smoke starting 7/28).

Appended: Sam's MAP + our procurement checklist.

Procurement Team
Integra Health
